title: Pauline Weaver — portrait drawing by Paul Christian (published 2002)

date.basis: The user identifies the reproduction as page 169 of Peggy Christian's 2002 book. The drawing is signed Paul Christian, but no creation date is visible.

caption: Posthumous, front-facing portrait drawing of Pauline Weaver in a broad-brimmed hat, signed Paul Christian and reproduced in Historic San Timoteo Canyon, page 169.
description: A modern artistic interpretation of frontiersman Pauline Weaver, photographed from Peggy Christian's 2002 local-history book. It is not a photograph or a documented portrait from life. This is a distinct composition from catalog record BLD-0090, another posthumous Weaver drawing shown in three-quarter profile; the two should remain separate and should not be treated as independent evidence of Weaver's appearance.
attribution: Drawing by Paul Christian; reproduced in Peggy Christian, Historic San Timoteo Canyon (2002), p. 169
caption_source: Visible artist signature plus the user-supplied filename identifying the book and page number.
rights_note: The book states Copyright 2002 by Peggy Christian and all rights reserved; the drawing may also be protected as Paul Christian's artwork. Permission is required before reproduction or publication.
